how: PixelLab v1 generate-image-pixflux, no init image, no_background true, view side, text_guidance_scale 9, seeds 6217 (idea 1) and 6234 (idea 2); size is 2x the shipping box; prompt = idea + suffix; then python3 tools/module_batch.py --post <raw> <out> (Solari palette) and copy the pick to tkg/art/sprites/modules/<id>.png
suffix: , strictly side-on with no perspective and no angle, a flat side profile. Dark gunmetal steel with brass bands, one small glowing orange point, dark outline, a single ship part, pixel art game sprite
negative: perspective, three-quarter view, top face, text, letters, numbers, background, floor, ground shadow, white, cream
